origin.description: Delete named files when the frame exits.

arguments.name: _file
arguments.text: Path or mapping of paths to delete.

origin.details: A string names the path. A mapping uses the names as paths. The files are removed on exit, whether or not the body created them.
origin.example:
td <- tempfile()
dir.create(td)
old <- getwd()
setwd(td)
on.exit(setwd(old), add = TRUE)
text <- local({
  local_file("file1")
  writeLines("foo", "file1")
  readLines("file1")
})
c(text, if (file.exists("file1")) "kept" else "gone")

translation.description: Delete named files when the frame exits.

arguments.name: _file
arguments.text: Path or mapping of paths to delete.

translation.details: A string names the path. A mapping uses the names as paths. The files are removed on exit, whether or not the body created them. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

td = tempfile.mkdtemp()
before = os.getcwd()
os.chdir(td)
try:
    with local_file("file1"):
        with open("file1", "w") as handle:
            handle.write("foo\n")
        text = open("file1").read().splitlines()[0]
    flag = "kept" if os.path.exists("file1") else "gone"
finally:
    os.chdir(before)
return [text, flag]
